This is a rapidly developing area, not an area of settled law. Even if our decision in Cotterman rendered the searches “plausibly . . . permissible,” it did not “specifically authorize” the cell phone searches at issue here. Lara, 815 F.3d at 613–14." (slip op., at 33–34)
